title: agoseris purpurea
intro: Agoseris purpurea, commonly known as Purple Rayless Goldenrod, is a flowering plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Agoseris purpurea include its ability to soothe and calm the body, reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
